productSentence: Send money to people, not wallet addresses.
loadBearingStatement: Human identifiers are mutable reachability routes, not financial identities or spending authority.
criticalInvariant: Reachability may change without silently changing recipient identity. A legitimate alias change that still resolves to the same PrismIdentity preserves continuity; an alias that now resolves to a different PrismIdentity must never silently redirect a payment — it is visibly blocked/reviewed as an identity discontinuity.

canonicalModel.whereMyMoneyLives: Monad account (Mera secp256k1 EOA holding USDC)
